errors.text: The proposed strain-rate range of 10^-4 to 10^2 s^-1 does not reconstruct the molecular-dynamics regime of 10^8 to 10^10 s^-1, so its explanation of rate insensitivity applies to a fundamentally different kinetic regime.
The hypothesis replaces vacancy-cluster/disordered-atom nucleation sites with unsupported solute obstacles and stacking-fault tetrahedra.
The cited evidence does not validate the proposed mechanism: E1 reports increasing strength with strain rate in a different alloy, while E2 concerns a BCC refractory HEA rather than FCC FeNiCrMn.
